title: Shadow Puppet
look: A dark leather puppet with punched-out holes, pressed against a lamp-lit screen.

doc.essence: Shadow theatre: a flat figure cut from dark hide, its decoration punched through so the lamp shines out of it, held against a glowing paper screen.
doc.notIt: Not papercut (one dark colour, light coming through holes, a lit screen), not one-bit (warm glow, no dither), not neon (solid silhouette).
doc.shapes: No outline: the silhouette is the drawing. Sharper corners and thinner limbs that taper to points, like jointed leather pieces. A second, softer shadow falls beside the figure on the screen.
doc.colour: Every area becomes near-black hide. The body is punched with a lattice of small holes and the belly with slots, both showing the warm lamp light.
doc.eyes: Small round holes the lamp shines through, and a small cut mouth.
pitfalls: Without the screen behind it the silhouette disappears on dark pages: keep the stage.
Holes behind the eyes compete with them: the lattice is kept sparse.
